name: Reactor Meltdown
disable: DC 45 Computers (master) or Crafting (master) to initiate shutdown procedures, or DC 47 Thievery (master) to vent the reactor; three total successes are required to disable the trap
routine: (1 action) As the reactor overheats, the trap deals (4d10+20) Fire Damage damage to creatures within 60 feet (Basic DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw save). All creatures in the area are exposed to incredible radiation. Each time the trap uses this routine, the area increases by 10 feet. When the routine's radius equals 100 feet, resolve the routine. Then, the reactor immediately explodes, using Nuclear Explosion.

generalAbilities.name: Nuclear Explosion
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The trap completed its routine with a radius of 100 feet

Effect The reactor explodes, dealing (4d10+20) Fire Damage damage in a 500 foot radius, bypassing the hardness of any items in the blast zone (Basic DC 46 Fortitude Saving Throw save). Everything in the area is exposed to incredible radiation. The area of the nuclear explosion becomes irradiated, leaking severe radiation for 50 years.

offensiveAbilities.name: Radiation Leak
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature views the reactor's sensors or console

Effect Creatures within 60 feet of the reactor are exposed to incredible radiation (DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw; page 91). The trap rolls initiative.
